text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.

Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
So let your heart be fully devoted to the LORD our God, as it is this day, to walk in His statutes and to keep His commandments.”
We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
